usedFor: Segmetrics shows where leads come from, and “Add or Update Contact” and “Add Purchase to Contact” feed it.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Add or Update Contact” in Segmetrics
bestTemplate.why: An incoming message becomes a tracked contact, so its source is recorded.

watchOut: “Remove Tags to Contact” takes tags off a contact, so check the tag name before it runs.
